searchText: <@!291925846556540928> what do you mean by releasing? merging the spec/ merge code to the beacon-chain/ deploy a test withdrawal contract? <@!291925846556540928> one of the option is to have ExitMessage stored signed onchain in eth1 in advance on start of validator with exit epoch, say, in a year. With public key you could verify it when BLS is avalialbe in eth1. It doesn't suit all cases, but it provides shared stakers enough level of confidence as if operator doesn't submit it, anyone could do it. this way every shared staked validator looks like a bond issue with specific exercise date
